Interactions were real clicks/typing except the file chooser, filled via DataTransfer on the same input change handler. limitations: Screenshots limited while the browser pane was hidden
No automated Playwright trace (registries blocked on this host)

supplemental_checks.ux_pass: 14 Oct UX pass on a fresh throwaway workspace (port 8091, MOCK, synthetic sandbox): every route (Home, Money, Plans, review dialog, Documents wizard, Activity + operation timeline, Settings, Copilot panel, sign-in, page-not-found) opened in the built-in browser pane. Measured document scrollWidth == clientWidth and no element past the viewport edge (tables and charts scroll inside their own wrappers) at 390, 768, 1366 and 1440 px; Copilot scroll area has no horizontal overflow at 390/768/1440. Real clicks through JS: options computed, plan selected, sandbox clock advanced, two exact approvals (one with simulated lost response), import wizard with an ambiguous date flagged. Wrong-token sign-in shows the inline error. No console errors besides the expected 401 session probe.
